description: urbisphere_gb-london_UR-3: Transport database derived from UK road networks, OSM, and TfL public transport timetables, for modelling in London, UK urbisphere–London Data Release and Technical Documentation is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Megan McGrory, Denise Hertwig (University of Reading, Urban Meteorology). Files included in this archive Documentation urbisphere_London_transport_database.pdf JSON Database files (JSON: https://www.loc.gov/preservation/digital/formats/fdd/fdd000381.shtml (last accessed: 30/3/2024)) driving_transport.json Database of driving routes cycling_transport.json Database of cycling routes walking_transport.json Database of walking routes public_transport.json Database of public transport routes Python 3.9 Code London_travel_dictionaries.py to create databases assign_speed_limits.py to assign OSM speed limits to each road in GLA reduce_sub_services.py ... Coverage: national (GB); the metadata date the deposit to 2024. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
